objective: Maximize cross-scope terminal wealth by allowing already-funded AI trend campaigns to compound through generic slow-trend wobble while retaining acute failure and active opportunity displacement.

evidence.account_diagnosis: In the joint optical-leader-removal account, most completed exits of these major winners are SECURITY_EXIT decisions rather than opportunity displacements. The gap therefore exists even without cross-sectional competition and is an ownership-lifecycle problem.
evidence.structural_gap: The parent base currently defines broken = slow trend.exit OR ret1 <= -8% OR quote not ready. This gives a generic 60-session trend edge the same liquidation authority as an acute security failure.

treatment.funded_campaign_exit: For an actually held symbol, a generic slow trend.exit is forgiven when the current causal alpha score remains strictly positive. The campaign becomes self-failed when the same already-observed causal score is <= 0.
always_authoritative: actual inventory reconciliation and next-session execution
unchanged: market trend required for new vacancy fills
retirement and readmission semantics except insofar as the current held campaign is no longer declared broken solely by slow trend.exit

structural_difference_from_old_failures.committed_offensive_core: That family still used the same slow trend.exit as a forced security break and had no active incumbent displacement. This treatment does the opposite combination: suppresses slow-trend liquidation for positive-alpha funded campaigns while retaining the later validated active replacement stack.
structural_difference_from_old_failures.profit_trend_shield: That family only shielded profitable holdings during market-shock/recovery states and retained the parent security exit semantics. This treatment is security-campaign lifecycle logic independent of market shock and explicitly changes slow trend.exit authority.
structural_difference_from_old_failures.basis_failure_exit: That family added an extra loss/EMA exit while explicitly preserving all parent security exits. This treatment removes one parent exit authority and substitutes existing causal alpha self-failure.

measurement.primary: mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary: minimum terminal wealth across the same scopes
measurement.promotion: Treatment must exceed the current campaign-peak mean-log objective without reducing the current minimum wealth; MDD/orders/turnover are diagnostics only during alpha discovery.
measurement.if_promoted: Run the same source-bound treatment on the full 896-session frozen history before any further structural composition.

prohibitions: no score threshold search around zero
no future return or future high in decisions
no change to frozen data or statistics
